.showdown-duel-card .duel-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.showdown-duel-card .duel-title>strong{color:#e6c49a;font-size:13px}.showdown-duel-card .duel-title .badge{font-size:9px;color:#d6b58d}

.duel-score-section{padding-top:4px}.duel-score-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 18px minmax(0,1fr);gap:9px;align-items:end;text-align:center}.duel-score-grid label{min-width:0}.duel-score-grid label>span{display:block;color:#c0c8cc;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;min-height:19px}.duel-score-grid input{display:block;margin:6px auto 0;width:100%!important;height:56px;max-width:125px;border:1px solid #856f54!important;background:#111b24!important;color:#f3dfc5!important;font-size:28px!important;font-weight:750;text-align:center;border-radius:11px}

.showdown-champion-card .champion-laurel{font-size:35px;color:#d8b781;letter-spacing:.15em}.showdown-champion-card h1{font-size:clamp(27px,5vw,43px);color:#f4d8aa!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.showdown-champion-card h2{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#e1c9a7}.champion-series-line{font-size:13px;color:#e9d1ac;margin-top:14px}
.showdown-reveal-layer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100000;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(5,12,18,.91);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);padding:15px}

.reveal-close{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;border:1px solid #9f8360;border-radius:20px;background:#222e36;color:#e3c89f;padding:7px 11px;z-index:1}.reveal-brand{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#d8c4a4}

.showdown-reveal-dialog h2{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#d6ba91}.showdown-reveal-dialog h1{font-size:clamp(34px,8vw,60px);color:#f4dbb3;line-height:1.12;overflow-wrap:anywhere;text-shadow:0 0 34px #c6995966}
.showdown-reveal-dialog p{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.27em;color:#d9bb8f}.showdown-reveal-dialog>small{color:#b8a98d;letter-spacing:.15em}.reveal-motes{position:absolute;inset:10% 0 auto;font-size:30px;color:#caab72;opacity:.4;letter-spacing:22px;animation:revealShimmer 3s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes revealEnter{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px) scale(.94)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}@keyframes trophyFloat{from{transform:translateY(0)}to{transform:translateY(-7px)}}@keyframes revealShimmer{50%{opacity:.8}}

<style id="showdown-0821-finish-polish">
/* v0.8.21 · light editorial motion. Static color tokens remain those of 4.8.92.18 master. */
.showdown-stage-tab:not(:disabled){transition:border-color .2s ease,background .2s ease,transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
.showdown-stage-tab:not(:disabled):active{transform:scale(.99)}
.showdown-stage-tab:focus-visible,.showdown-stage-share button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #d5b58d;outline-offset:3px}
.showdown-scoreboard .club-win{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.showdown-champion-card .champion-laurel{display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 19px rgba(207,172,115,.32))}
.showdown-share-layer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100050;background:rgba(5,10,15,.93);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(15px);backdrop-filter:blur(15px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(9px,2vw,22px);overflow-y:auto}
.showdown-share-layer[hidden]{display:none!important}
.showdown-share-dialog{width:min(510px,100%);max-height:calc(100dvh - 24px);overflow:auto;border:1px solid rgba(209,175,128,.52);border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#263440,#131d27 94%);box-shadow:0 25px 75px rgba(0,0,0,.66);padding:14px;color:#f5ece0;animation:sdShareIn .3s ease both}
.sd-share-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:3px 2px 11px}
.sd-share-top strong{font-size:11px;color:#ddbf97;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
.sd-share-close{background:#1a242d!important;color:#e8d0b0!important;min-width:38px;min-height:38px;padding:7px!important;border:1px solid #75634e!important;border-radius:10px!important}
.sd-share-image-frame{border:1px solid rgba(220,190,151,.33);background:#0d1821;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;width:min(100%,370px);margin:auto;box-shadow:0 12px 26px #0006}
.sd-share-image-frame img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:contain}
.sd-share-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin-top:13px}
.sd-share-actions button{font-size:12px;min-height:45px;border-color:#847058!important;background:#2b343d;color:#f5ece0;border-radius:10px!important}
.sd-share-actions button.primary{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#ab8458,#d4b58e)!important;color:#171c20!important;border-color:#dac197!important}
.sd-share-hint{text-align:center;color:#a9b7bf;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;margin:10px 0 2px}
.sd-share-feedback{font-size:11px;text-align:center;min-height:16px;color:#d9c6a9}
.sd-share-open{scrollbar-width:thin}
.showdown-reveal-dialog{border:1px solid #cfb088;box-shadow:0 24px 85px #000c,0 0 0 1px #d5bb8420,inset 0 0 64px #c49b4921}
.showdown-reveal-dialog:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 27%,rgba(234,195,132,.095) 50%,transparent 73%);animation:sdRevealLight 5s ease-in-out infinite}
.showdown-reveal-dialog .sd-reveal-stage{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:18px 0}
.sd-reveal-stage span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.065em;color:#dfc8a8;border:1px solid rgba(205,173,128,.35);background:#14222acc;border-radius:18px;padding:8px 9px}
.sd-reveal-score{font-size:13px;color:#e0c6a4;letter-spacing:.09em;margin:15px auto 0}
.sd-reveal-cta{margin-top:18px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.sd-reveal-cta button{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#a88054,#d4b58d);color:#172029;border-color:#e1c49b;min-height:42px}
.sd-reveal-particles{pointer-events:none;position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}
.sd-reveal-particles i{position:absolute;display:block;top:-7%;width:5px;height:12px;background:#e6be7f;opacity:.0;border-radius:2px;animation:sdConfetti var(--duration,5s) var(--delay,0s) ease-in infinite}
@keyframes sdConfetti{0%{transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(0deg);opacity:0}18%{opacity:.65}85%{opacity:.45}100%{transform:translateY(620px) rotate(370deg);opacity:0}}
@keyframes sdShareIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes sdRevealLight{50%{opacity:.3}}
@media(max-width:560px){.showdown-share-dialog{padding:11px}.sd-share-actions{gap:7px}.sd-share-actions button{padding:9px 6px;font-size:11px}.showdown-reveal-dialog{padding:40px 16px 36px}.sd-reveal-stage span{font-size:9px}}

@media print{.showdown-share-layer,.sd-reveal-particles{display:none!important}}
</style>
<style id="sd-0823-ipad-scoreboard-crop">
/* Team Showdown v0.8.23: photo composition on iPad and desktop.
   Keep original image intact; provide a soft full-bleed atmosphere and a
   smaller center-court focal view with feathered, invisible side edges. */
@media screen and (min-width:700px){
 .showdown-scoreboard{
   background-image:none!important;background-color:#14212c!important;isolation:isolate;
   min-height:clamp(234px,21vw,286px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;
   justify-content:space-between;padding:clamp(20px,2vw,29px) clamp(20px,3.2vw,48px);
 }
 .showdown-scoreboard::before{
   content:"";position:absolute;inset:-20px;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
   background:var(--sd-center-court) center 39%/cover no-repeat;
   filter:blur(16px) brightness(.47);opacity:.52;
 }
 .showdown-scoreboard::after{
   content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:50%;
   width:min(91%,1080px);transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
   background-image:linear-gradient(105deg,rgba(14,26,37,.70),rgba(13,25,35,.62) 50%,rgba(14,26,37,.70)),var(--sd-center-court);
   background-position:center center,center 40%;background-size:100% 100%,cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;
   -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent 0%,#000 20%,#000 80%,transparent 100%);
   mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent 0%,#000 20%,#000 80%,transparent 100%);
 }
 .showdown-scoreboard > *{position:relative;z-index:1}
 .showdown-scoreboard .board-inner{width:100%}
 .showdown-scoreboard .versus{
   display:grid;place-items:center;margin:auto;width:38px;height:38px;
   border:1px solid rgba(218,188,149,.32);border-radius:50%;
   background:rgba(13,23,33,.80);color:#e8d0aa;
   font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
 }
}
</style>
<style id="team-showdown-0825-final-results-stage-management">

.sd-final-hero .sd-replay-fab:hover{border-color:rgba(236,204,149,.82);background:rgba(16,24,32,.36);transform:translateY(-1px)}

.sd-final-hero h2{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#ead2ab;text-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}

.sd-final-hero .form-actions{position:relative;z-index:2;justify-content:center;max-width:520px;margin:22px auto 0}

.sd-inline-sparkles i{position:absolute;font-style:normal;font-size:18px;color:#e3c48d;opacity:0;top:21%;left:13%;text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(227,196,141,.33)}
.sd-inline-sparkles i:nth-child(2){left:31%;top:35%;font-size:13px}
.sd-inline-sparkles i:nth-child(3){left:82%;top:23%;font-size:16px}
.sd-inline-sparkles i:nth-child(4){left:69%;top:62%;font-size:12px}

.sd-final-hero .stage-winner-recaps .stage-recap-chip{background:rgba(8,15,22,.22)!important;border-color:rgba(214,183,128,.34)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(7px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px)}
.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating{animation:sdGlassArrival .94s cubic-bezier(.18,.72,.18,1) both,sdGoldPulse 2.1s ease-out .18s 1 both}

.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .form-actions{animation:sdChipFloat .95s ease-out .55s both}
.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-inline-sparkles i{animation:sdSparkle 2.9s ease-out both}
.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-inline-sparkles i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.2s}
.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-inline-sparkles i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.45s}
.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-inline-sparkles i:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.7s}
.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-inline-sparkles i:nth-child(5){animation-delay:1s}
@keyframes sdGlassArrival{0%{opacity:.15;transform:translateY(20px) scale(.985);border-color:rgba(196,163,111,.08)}72%{border-color:rgba(243,204,133,.9)}100%{opacity:1;transform:none;border-color:rgba(214,183,128,.52)}}
@keyframes sdGoldPulse{0%{box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.16),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03)}35%{box-shadow:0 24px 46px rgba(0,0,0,.28),0 0 0 1px rgba(244,204,133,.18),0 0 32px rgba(221,178,98,.22),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.07)}100%{box-shadow:0 18px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.24),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05)}}
@keyframes sdWinnerGlow{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.985);text-shadow:none}48%{opacity:1;text-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(242,191,100,.52)}100%{opacity:1;transform:none;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(242,191,100,.15)}}
@keyframes sdSparkle{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.62)}26%{opacity:.95}65%{opacity:.58}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-32px) scale(1.12)}}
@keyframes sdChipFloat{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}100%{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.sd-finished-layout{margin-top:14px}
.sd-stage-summary-list{min-width:0}
.sd-summary-list-heading{margin:0 0 12px;padding:3px 3px 0}
.sd-summary-list-heading span{color:#c9aa7c;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;font-weight:700}
.sd-summary-list-heading h2{margin:5px 0;font-size:19px}
.sd-summary-list-heading small{font-size:11px;color:#aab5bc}
.sd-stage-summary{margin:0 0 11px!important;padding:0!important;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(33,46,58,.92),rgba(18,29,39,.94))!important;border:1px solid rgba(205,180,143,.28)!important}
.sd-stage-summary>summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;list-style:none;padding:16px!important;cursor:pointer;min-height:77px;max-width:100%;user-select:none}
.sd-stage-summary>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.sd-summary-number{flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(208,176,127,.38);width:35px;height:35px;border-radius:9px;font-size:12px;color:#d7b889;font-weight:800}
.sd-summary-heading{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;text-align:left}
.sd-summary-heading strong{font-size:12px;color:#f1e6d8;letter-spacing:.06em}
.sd-summary-heading small{font-size:11px;color:#b8c0c7;line-height:1.35;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sd-summary-result{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:#e5c599;white-space:nowrap;text-align:right}
.sd-summary-result small{display:block;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.09em;color:#b8c0c7;font-weight:500;margin-top:3px}
.sd-summary-caret{flex:none;color:#d7b889;margin-left:4px;transition:transform .22s}
.sd-stage-summary[open] .sd-summary-caret{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.sd-summary-body{padding:0 15px 15px;border-top:1px solid rgba(196,181,156,.13)}
.sd-summary-facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin:14px 0}
.sd-summary-facts span{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.065em;color:#acb7bf;border:1px solid rgba(196,181,156,.18);border-radius:9px;padding:10px 8px;min-width:0}
.sd-summary-facts b{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#f0dac0;margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sd-summary-body .leaderboard-card{margin:10px 0!important;padding:13px!important}
.sd-results-title{font-weight:750;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#d4b58a;margin:18px 0 8px}
.sd-results-scroll{overflow:auto;max-height:450px;border:1px solid rgba(173,186,199,.17);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(8,18,26,.2)}
.sd-results-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px}
.sd-results-table th{text-align:left;position:sticky;top:0;background:#1b2935;color:#cfb38e;font-size:10px;z-index:1}
.sd-results-table th,.sd-results-table td{padding:9px 7px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(185,195,203,.14);min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sd-results-table .sd-result-score{white-space:nowrap;text-align:center;font-weight:750;color:#efd2a4}
.sd-duel-results{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:6px}
.sd-duel-result{display:grid;grid-template-columns:62px minmax(0,1fr) 72px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:11px 7px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(185,195,203,.13)}
.sd-duel-result:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.sd-duel-index{font-size:9px;color:#c9ac88;letter-spacing:.04em;font-weight:800}
.sd-duel-result div{min-width:0}
.sd-duel-result div small{display:block;color:#a8b6bf;font-size:9px}
.sd-duel-result div strong{display:block;color:#efe8dc;font-size:11px;font-weight:650;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sd-duel-score{font-size:17px;color:#efcc9e;white-space:nowrap;text-align:center}
.sd-duel-winner{grid-column:2/-1;color:#b0d3bb;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.055em}
@media(max-width:640px){.sd-stage-summary>summary{padding:12px!important;gap:8px}.sd-summary-heading strong{font-size:10px}.sd-summary-heading small{font-size:10px}.sd-summary-number{width:28px;height:28px}.sd-summary-result{font-size:19px}.sd-summary-facts{gap:5px}.sd-summary-facts span{padding:8px 6px;font-size:8px}.sd-summary-facts b{font-size:10px}.sd-duel-result{grid-template-columns:45px minmax(0,1fr) 48px minmax(0,1fr);gap:5px}.sd-duel-score{font-size:13px}.sd-duel-index{font-size:8px}.sd-duel-result div strong{font-size:10px}.sd-final-hero{padding:22px 16px 20px!important;min-height:255px}.sd-final-hero::after{width:82%;height:180px}.sd-final-hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,10vw,54px)!important}.sd-final-hero .form-actions{flex-wrap:wrap}.sd-final-hero .sd-replay-fab{right:12px;top:12px;min-width:40px;height:40px;padding:0 12px;font-size:11px}.sd-final-hero .over{padding-right:74px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating,.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating h1,.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-inline-sparkles i{animation:none!important}}
@media print{.sd-final-hero,.sd-stage-summary-list{break-inside:avoid}.sd-final-hero .form-actions{display:none}}
</style>
<style id="team-showdown-v0831-editorial-finale">
/* Single court venue photograph, editorial championship reveal. Stage engine unchanged. */
.sd-final-hero{
  display:flex!important;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0!important;min-height:350px!important;isolation:isolate;
  overflow:hidden;position:relative!important;
  background:rgba(15,26,35,.48)!important;
  border:1px solid rgba(208,174,121,.55)!important;
  box-shadow:0 17px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.18),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important;backdrop-filter:none!important;
}
.sd-final-hero::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(9,16,23,.55),rgba(9,16,23,.46) 17%,rgba(9,16,23,.62) 50%,rgba(9,16,23,.46) 83%,rgba(9,16,23,.55)),var(--sd-center-court);
  background-position:center center,center 38%;
  background-size:100% 100%,100% auto;
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
  filter:saturate(.85);
}
.sd-final-hero::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;max-width:none;width:auto;height:auto;
  transform:none;filter:none;opacity:1;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(9,17,25,.35) 0,transparent 22%,rgba(9,17,25,.16) 67%,rgba(9,17,25,.47) 100%);
}
.sd-final-hero>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.sd-final-hero .sd-inline-sparkles{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}
.sd-hero-bar{width:100%;min-height:78px;padding:19px 25px 10px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;text-align:left}
.sd-session-identity{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;max-width:min(77%,800px)}
.sd-session-identity small{font-size:9px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:.23em;color:#d3b98e;font-weight:700}
.sd-session-identity strong{font-size:clamp(12px,1.45vw,18px);letter-spacing:.035em;line-height:1.28;font-weight:650;color:#f2e6d7;overflow-wrap:anywhere;text-shadow:0 2px 9px rgba(0,0,0,.58)}
.sd-final-hero .sd-replay-fab{
  display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;right:auto;top:auto;flex:0 0 auto;
  width:40px;height:40px;min-width:40px;padding:0!important;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(10,19,26,.44)!important;border:1px solid rgba(217,183,136,.65)!important;
  color:#e9d1ad!important;box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.07),0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.16)
}
.sd-final-hero .sd-replay-fab svg{display:block;width:18px;height:18px;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.75;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform .26s ease}
.sd-final-hero .sd-replay-fab:hover svg{transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.sd-hero-center{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:1;min-width:0;padding:18px 20px 19px;text-align:center}
.sd-hero-award{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;color:#efcf96;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;font-weight:760;line-height:1.45;text-shadow:0 2px 11px #0009}
.sd-hero-award::before,.sd-hero-award::after{content:"";height:1px;width:35px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(226,197,151,.72))}
.sd-hero-award::after{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.sd-final-hero .sd-hero-center h1{font-size:clamp(43px,5.3vw,75px)!important;line-height:1.02!important;margin:11px 0 5px;max-width:90%;font-weight:690;letter-spacing:.008em;color:#ffe2b5!important;text-shadow:0 4px 25px #04090d,0 0 23px rgba(218,160,75,.28)}
.sd-hero-champion-sub{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.29em;color:#f4dfbf;font-weight:750;line-height:1.5;text-shadow:0 2px 10px #0008}
.sd-hero-series{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;margin:15px auto 0;padding:7px 17px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(8,17,24,.37);border:1px solid rgba(218,187,138,.49);backdrop-filter:blur(7px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px)}
.sd-hero-series small{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#d7bf9e;font-weight:700}
.sd-hero-series strong{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:760;color:#f7dfb9;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.sd-hero-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(226,203,170,.23);width:calc(100% - 52px);margin:0 auto 0;padding:12px 0 13px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;color:#dfc7a6;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.15em;font-weight:650;text-shadow:0 2px 7px #0008}
.sd-finished-layout{margin-top:17px!important}
.sd-summary-list-heading{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sd-summary-list-heading-copy{flex:1;min-width:0}
.sd-summary-share{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;white-space:nowrap;min-height:35px;padding:8px 11px!important;border:1px solid rgba(206,180,145,.37)!important;border-radius:9px!important;background:rgba(40,53,64,.52)!important;color:#e4c89f!important;font-weight:650;font-size:10px!important;letter-spacing:.01em}
.sd-summary-share svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.sd-summary-share:hover{background:rgba(71,61,50,.65)!important;border-color:rgba(217,180,121,.62)!important}
.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating{animation:sdGlassArrival .9s ease-out both,sdGoldPulse 2s .1s ease-out both}
.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-hero-award{animation:sdChipFloat .62s ease-out .12s both}
.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-hero-center h1{animation:sdWinnerGlow 1.9s .23s ease-out both}
.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-hero-champion-sub{animation:sdChipFloat .7s .45s ease-out both}
.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-hero-series{animation:sdChipFloat .8s .58s ease-out both}
.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-hero-bottom{animation:sdChipFloat .7s .76s ease-out both}
@media(min-width:700px) and (max-width:1050px){.sd-final-hero{min-height:330px!important}.sd-final-hero::before{background-position:center center,center 40%;background-size:100% 100%,100% auto}}
@media(max-width:699px){
.sd-final-hero{min-height:354px!important}
.sd-final-hero::before{background-size:100% 100%,auto 105%;background-position:center center,center 42%}
.sd-final-hero::after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,15,23,.47),rgba(8,15,23,.09) 28%,rgba(8,15,23,.18) 60%,rgba(8,15,23,.50))}
.sd-hero-bar{padding:14px 14px 6px;min-height:70px}
.sd-session-identity{max-width:calc(100% - 54px)}
.sd-session-identity small{font-size:8px}
.sd-session-identity strong{font-size:12px;line-height:1.26}
.sd-final-hero .sd-replay-fab{width:37px;height:37px;min-width:37px;padding:0!important}
.sd-final-hero .sd-replay-fab svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.sd-hero-center{padding:12px 11px 17px}
.sd-hero-award{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;gap:7px}
.sd-hero-award::before,.sd-hero-award::after{width:18px}
.sd-final-hero .sd-hero-center h1{font-size:clamp(34px,10vw,51px)!important;max-width:100%}
.sd-hero-champion-sub{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.17em}
.sd-hero-series{gap:8px;padding:6px 11px;margin-top:12px}
.sd-hero-series small{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.sd-hero-series strong{font-size:16px}
.sd-hero-bottom{width:calc(100% - 28px);padding:11px 0;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.045em}
.sd-summary-list-heading{align-items:flex-start}
.sd-summary-share{min-height:32px;padding:7px 9px!important}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating,.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-hero-award,.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-hero-center h1,.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-hero-champion-sub,.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-hero-series,.sd-final-hero.sd-celebrating .sd-hero-bottom{animation:none!important}}
@media print{.sd-final-hero .sd-replay-fab,.sd-summary-share{display:none!important}}
</style>

.sr-champ-label{color:#d5c19f;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:3px;font-size:10px}
.sr-hero h1{font-size:clamp(35px,7vw,68px);font-weight:850;letter-spacing:-1.5px;color:#f6d49e;margin:7px 0 19px;line-height:1.08;text-shadow:0 3px 24px #d7a65d27;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sr-series{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:24px;max-width:600px;margin:auto;border-top:1px solid #dbc09230;padding-top:18px}
.sr-series>div{min-width:105px;max-width:200px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.sr-series small{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2px;color:#e4e3df;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sr-series strong{font-size:29px;font-weight:750;color:#f3d6a8;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.sr-series-middle{font-size:9px;line-height:1.45;letter-spacing:1.6px;color:#b3a38c;max-width:105px}
.sr-stage-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:12px;margin:16px 0 28px}
.sr-stage-card{padding:18px 18px 16px;border-radius:15px;background:#142230;border:1px solid #435262a0;min-width:0}
.sr-eyebrow{font-size:10px;color:#c9a977;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:1.6px}
.sr-stage-card h3{font-size:20px;margin:8px 0 7px;color:#f4eee5;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sr-win{color:#f2cf93}.sr-draw{color:#d4dbe4}
.sr-stage-metric{font-size:13px;color:#e0e4e7;font-weight:700;margin-top:5px}
.sr-stage-detail{font-size:11px;margin-top:6px;color:#aab8c4}
.sr-content{padding:0 1px}
.sr-title-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px;margin:27px 4px 14px}
.sr-title-row h2{font-size:23px;color:#f2f1ed;margin:5px 0 2px;line-height:1.24}
.sr-title-row p{font-size:12px;color:#9faeb9;margin:3px 0 0;line-height:1.5}
.sr-count{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.2px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid #465564;color:#b2c1cc;padding:7px 12px;white-space:nowrap}
.sr-player-box{background:#172532;border:1px solid #45505b;border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden}
.sr-player-tools{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:13px 15px;border-bottom:1px solid #3b4956}
.sr-team-filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
.sr-root button.sr-filter{background:#22313e;color:#c3ccd3;border:1px solid #3c4c5b;border-radius:20px;padding:7px 13px;min-height:34px;font-weight:650;font-size:12px;line-height:1.15;cursor:pointer}
.sr-root button.sr-filter.active{background:#b79870!important;border-color:#dfba87!important;color:#111924!important}
.sr-root input[data-sr-search]{background:#111e2b;color:#f1f0ef;border:1px solid #405160;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 12px;min-width:190px;max-width:100%;height:36px;font-size:12px}
.sr-root input[data-sr-search]::placeholder{color:#9ba9b4}
.sr-players-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(160px,1fr) 80px 55px 48px 42px;padding:11px 43px 9px 15px;gap:6px;color:#abbbc8;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.55px;font-weight:700;border-bottom:1px solid #3b4956}
.sr-players-head span:not(:first-child){text-align:center}
.sr-person{margin:0;background:transparent;border-bottom:1px solid #354654}
.sr-person:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.sr-person[hidden]{display:none!important}
.sr-person summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;min-height:58px}
.sr-person summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.sr-person summary::marker{content:''}
.sr-person[open]{background:#1a2b39}
.sr-person-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex:1;min-width:0}
.sr-person-rank{font-size:12px;flex:none;color:#ac987b;width:20px;text-align:center}
.sr-person-name{font-size:13px;color:#f4f1ec;font-weight:700;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:1.3}
.sr-person-name small{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:450;margin-top:4px;color:#a8b4c0}
.sr-person-numbers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:80px 55px 48px 42px;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:center;color:#e0e4e7}
.sr-person-numbers b{font-weight:750}
.sr-person-numbers .sr-pos{color:#dcbd8b}
.sr-chevron,.sr-section-chevron{color:#cfb186;transition:transform .15s ease;font-size:19px;flex:none}
.sr-person[open] .sr-chevron,.sr-section[open] .sr-section-chevron{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.sr-person-detail{padding:2px 16px 12px 47px}
.sr-person-meta{padding:10px 0;color:#bdc8d1;font-size:11px;border-top:1px solid #4a5661}
.sr-person-match{display:grid;grid-template-columns:74px minmax(0,1fr) 64px 25px;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-top:1px solid #3a4a58;padding:10px 0}
.sr-person-stage{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.8px;color:#c4a87d;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.sr-person-opponent{min-width:0}.sr-person-opponent strong{font-size:12px;color:#ebeff0;font-weight:650;overflow-wrap:anywhere;display:block}.sr-person-opponent small{font-size:10px;color:#9baab8;display:block;margin-top:4px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sr-person-match>b{font-size:13px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#e8e9e9}
.sr-result-w{color:#e6c691;font-weight:800}.sr-result-l{color:#c8a6a5;font-weight:800}.sr-result-t{color:#c0c8d3;font-weight:800}
.sr-note{color:#98aab7;font-size:11px}
.sr-standings-help{padding:12px 15px;margin:0;border-top:1px solid #3b4956;line-height:1.5}
.sr-section{border:1px solid #465361;background:#172532;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;margin:10px 0}
.sr-section>summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:69px;padding:13px 17px;list-style:none;cursor:pointer}
.sr-section>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.sr-section>summary::marker{content:''}
.sr-section-icon{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.4px;flex:none;border:1px solid #9c815d;color:#e2bb82;border-radius:8px;width:32px;height:32px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.sr-section-label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;min-width:0;gap:4px}.sr-section-label strong{font-size:15px;color:#f1efe8;font-weight:750}.sr-section-label small{font-size:11px;color:#a8b5be;line-height:1.3}
.sr-scroll{overflow-x:auto;max-width:100%}
.sr-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:560px;font-size:12px}
.sr-table th{text-align:left;color:#b5c1ca;background:#213442;padding:11px 14px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.6px}
.sr-table td{padding:11px 14px;border-top:1px solid #3d4e5d;color:#e2e8e9;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.sr-table td strong{color:#f2efe8}.sr-table td small{display:block;color:#abb9c4;margin-top:4px}
.sr-matches{border-top:1px solid #44525f}
.sr-match{display:grid;grid-template-columns:126px minmax(0,1fr) 127px;gap:15px;align-items:center;padding:11px 17px;border-bottom:1px solid #344452}
.sr-match:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.sr-match-number b{color:#d0ac7e;font-size:11px;display:block;letter-spacing:.6px}
.sr-match-number small{font-size:10px;color:#95a7b7;margin-top:5px;display:block}
.sr-match-teams{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 85px minmax(0,1fr);gap:9px;align-items:center;text-align:center;min-width:0}
.sr-match-teams span{font-size:12px;color:#f3f2ee;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere;line-height:1.4}
.sr-match-teams b{font-size:19px;color:#f0d29d;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.sr-dash{color:#8799a6}
.sr-match-winner{font-size:11px;text-align:right;color:#d1ae7f;line-height:1.3;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sr-win-label{color:#e2bf89}
.sr-matches-heading{margin-top:33px}
.sr-public-footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.7px;color:#93a5b1;margin:27px 4px 0;border-top:1px solid #344557;padding-top:16px}
@media(max-width:650px){body.sd-public-only .wrap{padding:8px 9px}.sr-hero{border-radius:16px;padding:32px 14px 26px}.sr-kicker{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px}.sr-series{gap:8px}.sr-series>div{min-width:0;flex:1}.sr-series strong{font-size:25px}.sr-series-middle{font-size:8px;max-width:88px}.sr-stage-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:9px;margin-bottom:21px}.sr-stage-card{padding:14px 16px}.sr-stage-card h3{font-size:17px}.sr-title-row h2{font-size:20px}.sr-count{font-size:9px}.sr-player-tools{align-items:stretch}.sr-root input[data-sr-search]{width:100%;max-width:none}.sr-players-head{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 60px 39px 30px 26px;padding:9px 26px 8px 10px;gap:3px;font-size:8px}.sr-person summary{padding:10px 6px;gap:4px}.sr-person-title{gap:5px}.sr-person-rank{font-size:10px;width:18px}.sr-person-name{font-size:11px}.sr-person-name small{font-size:9px}.sr-person-numbers{grid-template-columns:60px 39px 30px 26px;gap:3px;font-size:10px}.sr-chevron{font-size:15px}.sr-person-detail{padding:2px 10px 12px}.sr-person-match{grid-template-columns:55px minmax(0,1fr) 45px 18px;gap:4px}.sr-person-stage{font-size:8px}.sr-person-opponent strong{font-size:11px}.sr-person-opponent small{font-size:9px}.sr-person-match>b{font-size:11px}.sr-match{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:7px;padding:12px 11px}.sr-match-number{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.sr-match-number small{margin:0}.sr-match-teams{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 54px minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px}.sr-match-teams span{font-size:11px}.sr-match-teams b{font-size:15px}.sr-match-winner{text-align:center;font-size:10px}.sr-section>summary{padding:11px 13px}.sr-section-label strong{font-size:12px}.sr-section-label small{font-size:10px}.sr-public-footer{font-size:9px}}
